items.title: James Lincoln Collier interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: Duke Ellington or Louis Armstrong, both of whom I’ve written about

ctx.x: Oh yeah it was commercial. This is commercial crap. And a lot of the baby got thrown out with the bath water a good deal of the time. But you have to remember if you listen to the best of Benny Goodman or the best of Count Basie or the best of Duke Ellington, whatever, you hear a lot of wonderful stuff. If you listen to a complete, the complete Bunny Berigan for example, you hear one dreary dance tune after the next. One after the next. One after the next, with a vocal and so forth and so on.
